# TubeReturns

TubeReturns ranks finance YouTubers by their actual stock-pick performance, measured against the S&P 500.

## What this site does

- Automatically discovers videos from tracked stock-picking YouTube channels
- Downloads transcripts and uses AI to extract explicit BUY stock picks
- Fetches historical stock prices from Yahoo Finance from the video's publication date
- Computes 1-month, 1-year, and 3-year returns for each pick
- Calculates alpha (outperformance vs SPY) per pick and per channel
- Ranks channels on a public leaderboard by average alpha

## What counts as a pick

Only explicit BUY recommendations for individual publicly-traded stocks are tracked. Crypto, ETFs, bonds, general market commentary, and "external positions" (stocks mentioned but not explicitly recommended) are excluded.

## Who can add a channel

Any registered user can suggest a channel. An AI eligibility check verifies the channel focuses on individual stock picks before it is added. Admins can bypass this check.

## Key concepts

- **Alpha**: the channel's average return minus the S&P 500 return over the same period, for picks that have matured
- **Eligible picks**: picks old enough for the return window to have closed (e.g. a 1-year pick requires the video to be at least 1 year old)
- **Unresolved picks**: picks where the stock ticker could not be identified — these are excluded from scoring but shown separately

## Data freshness

- New videos are discovered hourly
- Stock prices are refreshed three times daily
- Returns are locked once the measurement window closes (no retroactive changes)

## Source

All data is derived from publicly available YouTube transcripts and Yahoo Finance price data.
